_meta.description: Hard Negative Edges ontology for PV causality QC. Used by QCAgent to block invalid drug-AE causality inferences before LLM reasoning. Based on well-established pharmacological knowledge. Extend by adding entries to drug_class_rules or drug_specific_rules.

edge_types.DOES_NOT_TREAT: The drug has no therapeutic indication for the condition; inferring the condition is caused by the drug treating something else is invalid
edge_types.CONTRAINDICATED_WITH: The drug is formally contraindicated in patients with this condition; co-occurrence does NOT imply causality — it signals a prescribing error to be flagged separately
edge_types.NOT_INDICATED_FOR: The drug is not approved or indicated for this condition or symptom
edge_types.INCREASES_RISK_OF: The drug is known to INCREASE risk (positive causal signal — this is a VALID causality direction; do NOT use this as a hard block)
edge_types.DECREASES_EFFECT_OF: The drug attenuates or inhibits this biological process or drug

_meta.qc_rule: When QCAgent detects a causality_term of RELATED or POSSIBLY_RELATED for a (drug_class OR drug_name, ae_term) pair that appears in this ontology under a DOES_NOT_TREAT or CONTRAINDICATED_WITH edge, it MUST downgrade the assessment to UNLIKELY_RELATED or NOT_RELATED and populate HardNegativeViolation.

drug_class_rules.rationale: SSRIs inhibit serotonin reuptake in platelets, reducing aggregation. Increased clotting as a primary AE is pharmacologically inconsistent.
ACE inhibitors increase potassium retention via RAAS suppression. THIS IS A VALID CAUSAL DIRECTION — not a block.
Beta-blockers cause bradycardia. Tachycardia as a direct AE of a beta-blocker is pharmacologically inconsistent and likely represents a misattribution or rebound.
Anticoagulants prevent clot formation. Thrombosis as a primary AE of anticoagulant therapy is inconsistent unless related to heparin-induced thrombocytopenia (HIT) — flag for HIT workup separately.
Diuretics promote fluid excretion. Fluid retention as a direct AE is pharmacologically inconsistent unless tolerance or rebound is documented.
Statins are known to cause myopathy/rhabdomyolysis via CoQ10 depletion. VALID causal direction — not a block.
NSAIDs inhibit COX-1, reducing gastroprotective prostaglandins. GI bleeding is a well-established NSAID AE. VALID causal direction.
Corticosteroids cause insulin resistance and hyperglycemia. VALID causal direction.
Opioids cause constipation via mu-receptor activation in the gut. Diarrhea as a primary opioid AE is pharmacologically inconsistent (may indicate withdrawal).
Myelosuppression is expected with most cytotoxic chemotherapy agents. VALID causal direction.

drug_specific_rules.rationale: Metformin-associated lactic acidosis (MALA) is a rare but documented serious AE. VALID causal direction — requires renal function assessment.
Warfarin is prescribed specifically to prevent thrombosis. Thrombosis while on therapeutic warfarin may indicate INR under-anticoagulation — not a direct drug AE.

Digoxin slows heart rate via vagal stimulation. Tachycardia as a primary AE of digoxin is pharmacologically inconsistent at therapeutic doses; may indicate digitalis toxicity context which is a separate pattern.
Lithium causes fine tremor as a dose-dependent AE. VALID causal direction.
D2 antagonism by haloperidol causes EPS. VALID causal direction.
Amiodarone contains iodine (37% by weight) and is a well-documented cause of thyroid dysfunction and pulmonary toxicity. VALID causal direction.
Clozapine-induced agranulocytosis is a black-box warning requiring mandatory ANC monitoring. VALID causal direction.
